description: Code, quantized-graph recipes, calibration image lists, the frozen analysis plan and every per-model metric file behind the article "Size-Stratified Evaluation of INT8 and FP8 Quantization for Object Detection". Twenty-two official COCO checkpoints across five detector families (YOLO11, YOLOv8, YOLO26, D-FINE, RT-DETR), evaluated as real TensorRT engines on three measured devices (RTX 5090, RTX 4090, Jetson Orin Nano Super), with a replication under controlled training on TT100K. Datasets and detector checkpoints are not redistributed; they remain under their own licences.
